title: HSBC Launches RedCoin Payments on PayMe
why_it_matters: The launch puts a regulated bank-issued stablecoin into an established retail payment channel, but separates today's payment utility from future tokenized-investment access.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

HSBC Launches RedCoin Payments on PayMe

HSBC's Hong Kong dollar-referenced RedCoin is now usable for PayMe transfers and merchant payments, while tokenized investment subscriptions remain a planned feature.
